YH Verge3D sample runtime location

Do not download any runtime from this project. Copy the required local runtime files from your licensed Verge3D installation's build folder into this directory, preserving their relative paths. The sample expects v3d.js at:
  public/vendor/verge3d/v3d.js
Keep any runtime support files beside it (or in their original subfolders). The Verge3D runtime is not bundled or redistributed here.
